newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL PLAYERS BACK SACKED DOCKERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL PLAYERS BACK SACKED DOCKERS.

text.p: Two Liverpool footballers showed solidarity with 500 sacked dockers by wearing T-shirts supporting the men at Thursday's European Cup Winners' Cup match against Brann Bergen of Norway.

Robbie Fowler, who scored twice in Liverpool's 3-0 victory, lifted up his red Liverpool shirt after scoring his second goal to display the T-shirt underneath which read: "Support The 500 Sacked Dockers".
Liverpool manager Roy Evans said he was unaware the player had been wearing the T-shirt. UEFA regulations prohibit players from displaying any political logos at matches.
The dispute has been going on for two years since the men were sacked from Liverpool Docks.
Steve McManaman said: "The T-Shirts are on sale all over the city and I bought two of them. I wore one and gave one to Robbie."
